# **Reflected XSS into HTML context with most tags and attributes blocked**

Task: This lab contains a reflected XSS vulnerability in the search functionality but uses a web application firewall (WAF) to protect against common XSS vectors.

To solve the lab, perform a cross-site scripting attack that bypasses the WAF and calls the `print()` function.

Toolkit: Burpsuite, Browser

1. send req GET /?search=asdf HTTP/2 to Intruder  
2. Add payload section on search term and add payloads from cheat-sheet, start sniper attack  
3. all payloads will be blocked by waf with code 400, except \<body\> tag, and onresize, onsecuritypolicyviolation, ontouchcancel events

4. dut this payload wont work by itself, because it need user to resize window, so we add command to JS to resize window, it triggers our payload

add in body with iframe and deliver ti victim
